section.content: 待机状态下存储器中浪费的功耗被降低了而不降低从存储器读出数据的操作速度。半导体集成电路具有能够进入激活状态或待机状态的存储器，且存储器具有存储单元与之连接的位线和源线的电压发生电路。电压发生电路响应于从激活状态到待机状态转换的指令，使位线的电位和源线的电位彼此相等。电压发生电路响应于从待机状态到激活状态转换的指令，产生位线与源线之间的电位差。在待机状态中，位线的电位和源线的电位彼此相等。因此，在各个存储单元的源与漏之间不出现子阈值泄漏。在激活状态中，源线电位不变化。因此，不降低数据读出操作的速度。

A semiconductor integrated circuit has a memory which can enter active state or standby state, and the memory has voltage generation circuits for bit lines and source lines with which memory cells are connected. The voltage generation circuits make the potential of the bit lines and the potential of the source lines equal to each other in response to an instruction to transition from active state to standby state. The voltage generation circuits produce a potential difference between the bit lines and the source lines in response to an instruction to transition from standby state to active state. In standby state, the potential of the bit lines and that of the source lines are equal to each other. Therefore, sub-threshold leakage does not occur between the source and drain of each memory cell. In active state, the source line potential is not varied.

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) and integrated circuit cardTechnical field

The present invention relates to the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) that is equipped with storer, relate to the technology that is used for reducing the leakage current of storage unit under the low power consumpting state such as holding state of the microcomputer that for example can be applicable to be equipped with high capacity ROM more precisely.

Background technology

Exist a kind of technology that power consumption prevents to increase simultaneously access delay again that is used for reducing.According to this technology, when making the substrate bias of peripheral circuit when DRAM is activated, be different from DRAM to be in holding state.Thereby the sub-threshold value of memory peripheral circuit when standby leaked and is suppressed and achieve the above object (referring to patent documentation 1).

According to another kind of technology, the bit line of the storage unit of selected access and source line were not guided the bit line current potential into when storer was activated.Thereby the sub-threshold value of the storage unit of selected access is not leaked and is suppressed (referring to patent documentation 2).

Patent documentation 1 is based on suppress the viewpoint that sub-threshold value is leaked under holding state.But this document relates to peripheral circuit, does not relate to the memory cell array of explaining the chip area major part.Be different from the present invention aspect the purpose that reduces power consumption.In addition, patent documentation 1 disclosed technology is threshold voltage control.It need be than relatively large accessory circuit, comprises reference voltage generating circuit, substrate bias generation circuit, optionally connects the transistor etc. of power supply terminal and substrate bias terminal.

Patent documentation 2 disclosed technology are that the bit line and the source line of non-selected storage unit guided the bit line current potential into when storer is activated.Utilize this technology, can reduce the power wastage under the state of activation; But also might reduce access rate.More particularly, before the beginning read operation, the state exchange of selected access never must be discharged to the source line of the state of selected access.Finish the required time and prolonged the read operation cycle owing to waiting for discharge operation.

Summary of the invention

The purpose of this invention is to provide a kind of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit), wherein can reduce the power dissipation that storer consumed and do not make circuit complicated in holding state.

Another object of the present invention provides a kind of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit), the power dissipation that is consumed in the time of wherein can reducing the storage unit standby and do not reduce the operating speed of reading data from storer.

From the description of this instructions and accompanying drawing, above-mentioned purpose and features of novelty with other of the present invention will be apparent.

Being summarized as follows of the disclosed typical case's invention of the present invention of this instructions:

(1) SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of situation 1 comprises the storer that can enter state of activation or holding state according to the present invention.This storer has the bit line that storage unit is attached thereto and the voltage generating circuit (19,20,21,22) of source line.In response to the instruction of conversion from the state of activation to the holding state, voltage generating circuit is equal to each other the current potential of bit line and the current potential of source line.In response to the instruction of conversion from the holding state to the state of activation, voltage generating circuit produces potential difference (PD) between bit line and source line.

According to above-mentioned situation of the present invention, in holding state, the current potential of bit line and the current potential of source line are equal to each other.Therefore, in each source of storage unit and do not occur sub-threshold value fully between leaking and leak.In state of activation, potential difference (PD) is created between bit line and the source line.Thereby do not adopt wherein selected or not selected and between bit line and source line, produce the control technology of potential difference (PD) according to storage unit.Therefore, the operating speed of reading data from storer is not lowered.

If adopt the voltage generating circuit that makes source line current potential equal the bit-line pre-charge current potential, the then best following formation of voltage generating circuit as mentioned above under holding state: voltage generating circuit discharges to the source line in response to the instruction of conversion from the holding state to the state of activation.And, change its current feed ability, discharge rate is progressively increased.Importantly, the source line only must have the ability of drawing in electric current by the storage unit of selecting in the state of activation.More than be to flow to this provenance line in order to prevent that electric current from concentrating simultaneously from a large amount of storage unit.So just prevented big generating noise.

(3) SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of situation 3 comprises the storer that can enter state of activation or holding state and central processing unit that can reference-to storage according to the present invention.This storer comprises the storage unit that is connected with the source line with bit line.Storer makes the current potential of source line equal the precharge potential of bit line under holding state, and guides the source line into discharge potential under state of activation.Under holding state, make bit line current potential and source line current potential equal the bit-line pre-charge current potential.Therefore, in the source of storage unit and do not occur sub-threshold value fully between leaking and leak.Under state of activation, potential difference (PD) is created between bit line and the source line.Thereby do not adopt wherein selected or not selected and between bit line and source line, produce the control technology of potential difference (PD) according to storage unit.Therefore, the operating speed of reading data from storer is not lowered.Under state of activation, the source line only must be in discharge level, and its current potential needn't change between some point.Therefore, it is very little to the operating influence in the state of activation to be used for making source line current potential in the holding state to equal the existence of circuit of bit-line pre-charge current potential.Circuit can be simplified.

As specific embodiment, central processing unit is carried out the dormancy instruction in state of activation, and is transformed into holding state.In order further to reduce the power consumption in the holding state, clock signal generator is provided, it produces internal clocking by external clock.Clock signal generator is exported internal clocking in state of activation, and stops the output of internal clocking in holding state.And, pressure regulator is provided, it produces internal electric source by external power source.In holding state, pressure regulator is reduced to the builtin voltage state numerical value that is lower than internal electric source state in the state of activation.

(7) IC-card of another situation of the present invention has SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) and external connecting electrode on the card substrate.Optionally make SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) enter holding state or state of activation, and SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) comprise central processing unit and storer.This storer comprises the storage unit that is connected with the source line with bit line.This SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) is in response to from the reset instruction of outside and carry out initialization.Integrated circuit is with the initialized notice outside of finishing, so that be transformed into state of activation.In state of activation, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) produces predetermined potential difference (PD) between the bit line of storer and source line.And integrated circuit makes central processing unit in response to from the instruction of outside and deal with data.Carry out the dormancy instruction by means of central processing unit, integrated circuit is transformed into holding state.In holding state, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) is reduced to the numerical value that is lower than the potential difference (PD) in the state of activation with the potential difference (PD) between memory bit line and the source line.Integrated circuit is transformed into state of activation in response to the standby ring off signal.In this transfer process, the predetermined potential that integrated circuit produces between bit line and the source line by means of the discharge of source line is poor.Thereby integrated circuit has progressively improved discharge rate.

(8) SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of another situation comprises the storage unit that is connected with the source line with bit line according to the present invention; And the voltage generating circuit of bit line and source line.SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) is selectively placed on holding state or state of activation.In state of activation, the predetermined potential that voltage generating circuit produces between bit line and the source line is poor.In holding state, circuit takes place the potential difference (PD) between memory bit line and the source line is reduced to numerical value less than potential difference (PD) in the above-mentioned state of activation.As specific embodiment, voltage generating circuit is carried out following operation in the transfer process of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) from the holding state to the state of activation: the above-mentioned predetermined potential that the generation circuit produces between bit line and the source line by means of the discharge of source line is poor.Thereby circuit takes place progressively improved discharge rate.

The effect that the disclosed typical case's invention of this instructions produces is summarized as follows:

Because the current potential of bit line and the current potential of source line are equal to each other, so between the source of storage unit and leakage, do not occur sub-threshold value leakage fully.Under state of activation, potential difference (PD) is created between bit line and the source line.Thereby do not adopt wherein selected or not selected and between bit line and source line, produce the control technology of potential difference (PD) according to storage unit.Therefore, the operating speed of reading data from storer is not lowered.

If make the current potential of source line equal the precharge potential of bit line when standby, then the source line is discharged in response to the instruction of conversion from the holding state to the state of activation.Its electric current deliverability just changes, and discharge rate is progressively improved.So prevented that electric current is simultaneously from the concentrated source line that flows to of a large amount of storage unit.As a result, just prevented big generating noise.
